# Logitech Squeezebox via Lyrion

Read player status and control Squeezebox playback or volume through Muse Home Link, via an existing local Lyrion/Squeezebox server and its JSON-RPC HTTP endpoint. For players already connected to that server only: no new server deployment, no direct SlimProto implementation, and Home Link is not a media server, so agent-local files are not automatically reachable by Lyrion or the player.
